record_type_quote: To exclude off-target effects and to further confirm the specific function of the isolated Jiv90 domain of DNAJC14 in the pestiviral life cycle, we conducted gene rescue experiments in our MDBK and SK6 DNAJC14-KO cell lines.

targets.authors: Lackner T, Müller A, Pankraz A, Becher P, Thiel H-J, Gorbalenya AE, Tautz N.
targets.title: Temporal modulation of an autoprotease is crucial for replication and pathogenicity of an RNA virus.
targets.evidence_quote: The observation that the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon exhibited a lower replication efficiency than the NS2-5B/CP7 WT replicon in naive MDBK cells at 24 h and 48 hpe argues that the DNAJC14-mediated temporal regulation mechanism of NS2-3 cleavage during the replication of the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon contributes to this lower replication efficiency and is in line with the lower RNA replication efficiency known for NCP7 infections than CP7 infections (14).
targets.outcome_quote: The observation that the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon exhibited a lower replication efficiency than the NS2-5B/CP7 WT replicon in naive MDBK cells at 24 h and 48 hpe argues that the DNAJC14-mediated temporal regulation mechanism of NS2-3 cleavage during the replication of the NS2-5B/NCP7 WT replicon contributes to this lower replication efficiency and is in line with the lower RNA replication efficiency known for NCP7 infections than CP7 infections (14).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The new replicon experiment explicitly compares and agrees with the reported NCP7-versus-CP7 RNA replication difference.
